scope: Declared vocabulary for capability suggestions only. A match is a provisional candidate, never admission or support. A source-bound operation is suggested only when the request matches its applicability predicate.

manuscript-build.summary: Build a PDF manuscript or note from retained run results with pdflatex.

ntuple-inventory.summary: Inventory supplied MC/data samples and prepare streaming inputs for a new search.

mc-expected-construction.summary: Construct expected signal/control-region yields from complete MC streams.

asimov-sensitivity.summary: Asimov discovery-sensitivity diagnostics for a new search.

mc-closure.summary: MC closure tests of a frozen background strategy.

literal-calculation.summary: Exact finite dimensionless arithmetic stated in the request.

root-stream.summary: Stream ROOT trees with explicit member, DSID, weight and blinding contracts.

tree-array-export.summary: Source-bound array export with fixed input names, multiplicities and handoff; not a general tree-to-array exporter.

applicability.bound_to: its pinned prompts, fixed input file names, fixed object multiplicities and fixed output handoff

cosmic-evolution.summary: Cosmological initial conditions and N-body/hydro evolution with CosmicIC/Nyx.

published-classifier.summary: Apply a published classifier to supplied events or quantities.

mssm-observable-map.summary: Map supplied MSSM spectra and decays to lifetimes and observables.

nmssm-yukawa-map.summary: NMSSM tree-level spectrum convention to neutral-Higgs predictions.

width-inputs.summary: Source-bound width-input materialization for one release's tables; not a general table materializer.

applicability.bound_to: one release's file names, hashes, columns, bins and mass nodes

mass-width-grid.summary: Source-bound width study with fixed regions, normalization and scan domain; not a general resonance-width study.

applicability.bound_to: one analysis's regions, collision energy, luminosity, transfer-function degree, efficiency and scan domain

analysis-response-features.summary: Event-response features from retained multi-b analyses.

classifier-inputs.summary: Static census of an ONNX model tensor interface.

llp-plane-recipe.summary: Mass/lifetime plane recipes for long-lived particles.

svj-recipe.summary: Source-bound hidden-sector grid recipe with fixed axes and generation settings; not a general model-grid recipe.

applicability.bound_to: one search's luminosity, interpretation, parameter axes and generation configuration

research-comparison.summary: Complete-cell comparison of supplied scalar or interval results.

model-events.summary: MG5 generation from a full UFO with decays, shower matching and multiweights.

analyze.summary: Run preserved Rivet/SimpleAnalysis routines or constructed analyses over supplied events.

quantities.summary: Signed, grouped event moments in declared bins.

measurement.summary: Inference with supplied Gaussian measurement models and covariance.

domain.summary: Bounded supplied-artifact and fixed phase-space operations.

contrast.summary: Paired normalized contrasts between event-weight arms.

statistical-model.summary: Construct Poisson SR/CR and ABCD models with correlated auxiliaries.

model-portfolio.summary: SModelS simplified-model decomposition of a supplied spectrum.

likelihood-parity.summary: Fixed-vector likelihood parity against an independent density.

numerical-reference-check.summary: Held-out numerical comparisons against supplied references.

signal-template.summary: Complete SR/CR signal templates for published pyhf models.

stau-events.summary: Source-bound hadronic-tau projection with one source's channels and cuts; not a general tau selection.

applicability.bound_to: one source's channels and signal- and control-region cuts

native-likelihood.summary: Native CMS Combine likelihood on supplied datacards and workspaces.

full-auxiliary-calibration.summary: Fixed-truth auxiliary calibration with the native likelihood.

background-discrete-profile.summary: Discrete-profiling envelope over background function candidates.

eft-functions.summary: Exact CMS PhysicsModel EFT response polynomials.

normalized-measurement.summary: Gaussian contrasts of normalized SM+BSM mixtures.

continuous-fit.summary: Extended exponential fits in signal/control ranges.

native-statistical-construction.summary: Transport reviewed RooFit graphs to native fit bundles.

model-inputs.summary: Static diagnosis of supplied model inputs and generator cards.

ratio-measurement.summary: Fixed-prediction Gaussian ratio diagnostics with joint covariance.

group-normalization.summary: N/W normalization of independent event groups.

source-tables.summary: Literal HEPData primary tables with declared basis and covariance join.

scientific-delivery.summary: Primary resource capture and report delivery for a supplied portfolio.

published-summary.summary: Declared literature census and published-limit overlay.

native-group-acquisition.summary: Source-bound native event-group acquisition for its recognized routines.

applicability.bound_to: the recognized routines whose identities fix fill geometry and semantics

retained-shower.summary: Fresh parton shower of a retained LHE cohort.

derived-quantities.summary: Finite derived quantities with delta-method covariance.

finite-mc.summary: Finite-MC statistical models under supplied generator laws.

pdf-variations.summary: Coherent PDF variations of supplied parton records.

model-sources.summary: Symbolic model source detection and export.

model-tool-bridge.summary: UFO parameter and tree-process validation through MG5.

model-derivation-bridge.summary: Derive Feynman rules and a fresh UFO from a FeynRules model.

model-ward.summary: Ward-identity diagnostics of a supplied UFO.

mpi-observer.summary: Source-bound multiple-parton-interaction observer qualification for one retained event population.

applicability.bound_to: one experiment's event population, selected count, stage list and resource envelope

initialized-settings-qualification.summary: Qualify initialized shower settings on retained LHE.

initialized-settings-retained.summary: Source-bound qualification of the immutable outputs of one retained failed run.

applicability.bound_to: the recorded error text, exit code and phase history of one failed run

mpi-paired-effect.summary: Source-bound paired MPI on/off study with a fixed point and population; not a general paired contrast.

applicability.bound_to: fixed masses, event count, normalization, seed and channel population

likelihood-profile-probe.summary: Source-bound replay of one retained conditional likelihood profile under two protocols.

applicability.bound_to: one retained likelihood's dimensions and evaluation history

likelihood-candidate-check.summary: Source-bound check of one retained conditional-profile candidate history.

applicability.bound_to: one retained likelihood's candidate history and evaluation census

likelihood-step-refinement.summary: Source-bound finite-difference step refinement for one retained likelihood.

applicability.bound_to: one retained likelihood's dimensions and step history

cr-signal-qualification.summary: Fixed control-region signal intervention without a fit.

joint-score.summary: Source-bound successor study of one fit campaign; not a general score test.

applicability.bound_to: one fit campaign's design, solver commitments and selected mass cases

hs3-likelihood.summary: HS3 graph import and native RooFit likelihood evaluation.

feyn-graph.summary: Complete model-bound Feynman diagram enumeration and rendering.

diagram-analysis.summary: Enumerated diagram population into NDA/EDA consumers.

feynarts-amplitude.summary: FeynArts model to complete FeynCalc amplitude population.

checkmate-events.summary: CheckMATE signal-region tables from supplied HepMC2 events.

sfitter-observed-events.summary: LHE/analysis observations to the SFitter extractor.

eft-toolchain.summary: EFT running, matching and flavour predictions with flavio/wilson/smelli.

parameter-space-sampling.summary: Source-bound scan adapter for its stored question population; not general parameter-space sampling.

applicability.bound_to: its built-in stored question population and the task identities recorded with it

dataset-query-quantities.summary: Source-bound columnar adapter for its stored released-question population; not a general columnar analysis.

applicability.bound_to: its stored released-question identities and their observable counts

contur-yoda.summary: Single-point Contur inference from a supplied Rivet YODA.

contur-companion.summary: Source-bound released companion operations and tests of one tool release.

applicability.bound_to: the released companion operations and tests of one tool release

ma5-saf.summary: Source-bound SAF delivery for one fixed booking layout; not general SAF delivery.

applicability.bound_to: one source hash and its fixed region, histogram and cut-entry counts

resonance-width.summary: Tree-level two-body widths and branching ratios of a spin-0 or spin-1 resonance into declared fermion channels.

columnar-analysis.summary: Apply a declared object, region and histogram recipe to Delphes ROOT, ntuple or LHE events and deliver binned yields, cutflows and provenance.

authored-analysis.summary: Run agent-written Python for an analysis step that no declarative recipe expresses, as pinned attempts in a sandbox with a typed repair loop.

formula-grid.summary: Evaluate declared closed-form formulas (widths, branching ratios, bands, k-factors) over a parameter grid with cited or requester-stated constants.

coupling-morphing.summary: Fit a polynomial in couplings (declared basis, amplitude coupling orders or total degree) to cross sections or binned yields from several runs; condition number, required held-out closure, width declaration and coefficient covariance.

prescribed-statistic.summary: Evaluate the statistic a request prescribes (closed-form significance, Delta(-2 ln L) or Delta chi2 threshold, per-bin profile likelihood, combined experiments) as the primary result, with CLs alongside.

search-statistics.summary: Build SR/CR/VR pyhf models from yields: expected and observed discovery significance, CLs, background-only control-region fits with pulls and validation-region residuals.

differential-likelihood.summary: Gaussian likelihood for a measured differential spectrum with full covariance, prediction-dependent covariance laws, signed interference terms, profiled nuisances, scans and toy limits.

cross-section.summary: Look up a published signal cross section with its uncertainty under an explicitly selected order, PDF and scale convention; interpolate in mass and refuse silent fallback.
tools: LHC SUSY Cross Section Working Group

simplified-spectrum.summary: Write an SLHA2 card for a declared simplified-model spectrum with decoupled states, mixing and decay tables, and check decay closure.

resonance-lineshape.summary: Evaluate leading-order partial widths of spin-0 and spin-1 resonances, fixed-width, running-width and complex-pole propagators, and check the declared total width against the sum of partial widths.

model-authoring.summary: Author a FeynRules model extending the Standard Model from a typed ModelSpec or template (leptoquarks, neutral vector, axion-like particle, singlets), lint it, check Hermiticity, diagonal and canonical terms in two gauges, export and check a UFO.

figure-comparison.summary: Digitise a published figure, compare a result with a published curve, histogram, contour or HEPData table under declared transformations and tolerances, and draw parameter-plane and measurement figures overlaid on the official figure.

amplitude-predictions.summary: Exact post-hoc reweighting of stored amplitudes into binned predictions for any coupling, mass, width and propagator choice.

weighted-events.summary: Weighted points as LHE or HepMC3 events with named weights, run through any Rivet routine with RAW absolute normalization.

reco-ntuple-routine.summary: Run a native SimpleAnalysis routine port on flat reconstructed ntuples through a supplied branch and ID-flag map.

lhe-transform.summary: Rewrite LHE particles by declared (status, PDG) rules with an optional mass reset, proving that weights, init block and momenta are unchanged and listing the shower settings the change requires.

generation-reconciliation.summary: Compare a declared physics intent (process, conjugates, coupling orders, masses, widths, couplings, PDF, energy, fiducial cuts, virtuality windows) with MadGraph proc, run and parameter cards.

event-production.summary: Shower LHE events with Pythia 8 and simulate the detector with Delphes for any generated sample, with MLM matching, an invisible-state card gate, output contracts and a production receipt.

ml-training.summary: Train and compare pinned binary classifiers with baselines, equal epoch budgets, multiple seeds, and one withheld test evaluation.
